rationale: Signed by default: every artifact manifest is signed with the repository's Ed25519 key (key_id sha256:018ff423dfc30ca1) and verified against the CS_PUBLIC_KEY trust anchor before publication, before the last-known-good snapshot, and again in the visitor's browser. Unsigned publication is disabled so that losing the signing secret fails the deploy loudly instead of silently downgrading trust. Flip this to true only together with editing the tripwire assertion in tests/unit/test_pages_deploy_workflow.py, so the downgrade is a deliberate, reviewed change.
